title: 6.5.26 Challenges — Extended Save Features
description: Extend your save system: save file previews (show slot contents before loading), save timestamps, multiple profiles, or a 'delete all saves' with double-confirmation.

steps.title: Choose a challenge
steps.instructions: Read through the four challenge options in content.md and pick the one that interests you most. Each one extends your save system in a different direction.
hints: content.md describes all four options with hints. Pick one and commit to it.

steps.title: Implement the feature
steps.instructions: Starting from your A16.1 save system, add the challenge feature. Make sure the core save/load functionality still works — your extension should add capability, not break existing saves.
hints: Test your existing save/load before adding the new feature so you know it still works.
Save a backup copy of your A16.1 script.js before modifying it.

steps.title: Test with reloads
steps.instructions: Reload the page and verify your feature survives. Saves with timestamps should still show accurate times. Profile switching should keep player data separate. Bulk delete should wipe everything and let you start fresh.
hints: Open the browser console (F12) and check for errors when loading saves.
If timestamps show NaN, check that you're storing a number, not a string.
